feeds.title: Pf Media
feeds.description: Pf Media represents Pf Magazine, PharmaJobs, and Pf Awards in supporting pharma, life sciences, and health. This Pf Media website delivers up-to-date pharma news, multimedia insight, opinion, and virtual events. It is supported by our quarterly Pf Magazine which brings quality thought-leadership, opinion, analysis, comment, and interviews to the desks of pharma professionals. We also publish our special Pf Awards Brochure celebrating the fantastic achievements of the industry.

At Pharmaphorum We are publishers, consultants, and creatives bringing healthcare together. We support our pharmaceutical industry clients through both the reach and reputation of our publication and our consultative and creative capabilities in marketing, medical, communications, and digital innovation.
